text:
rachael: small docs bug: /v1/embed bulk example uses an array of objects but codegen expects an array of strings. openapi example currently: {
  "inputs": [{"text": "hello"}, {"text": "world"}]
}

tom: ah yes that changed during the embed API refactor. the request accepts either array<string> or {input: string} depending on endpoint. which file is this in?

rachael: docs/embeddings.md line ~120. the example shows "inputs" as objects but the live API accepts ["hello","world"]. the SDKs generate client examples using the OpenAPI example so they're wrong.

amir: can you file a PR to switch to the string-array example and add a short note about legacy object form? docs-lintbot flagged the example for mismatched schema type.

rachael: PR opened https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/docs/pull/545. changes: update example to accept array of strings, add migration note, and fix Python snippet.

docs-lintbot: lint error: example payload indent inconsistent with docs style guide on line 123.
tom: pushed a tiny fix, tests pass, merging now.

rachael: thanks. will monitor SDK owners channel for follow-ups.
